testInfo.description: oauth2as example OP, OIDC basic certification profile
testInfo.summary: This test calls the authorization endpoint test twice. The first time it includes max_age=15000 (so that the OP is required to return auth_time in the id_token). The second time it includes max_age=10000, and the authorization server must not request that the user logs in. The test verifies that auth_time and sub are consistent between the id_tokens from the first and second authorizations.
